name: verified-memory
description: Offline read-only search over a checksum-verified, optionally signed memory pack, with exact quotes
long_description: Pick a memory pack folder (made with the pack maker at https://python1.github.io/data-lore-hive/) and Claude can search it and quote it exactly. The whole pack is verified when the extension starts; if any check fails, it refuses to start. Read-only and offline: no network, no file writes, no accounts. Optionally require that the pack is signed by a key you pin or trust, refuse revoked keys and older packs, and stop answering if the pack folder changes while running.

tools.name: verified_memory_search
tools.description: Search the verified memory pack by all query words; returns up to 10 matches with exact quotes, source message IDs, dates and speakers.

tools.name: verified_memory_get
tools.description: Retrieve one full record from the verified memory pack by its M- record ID, with citations and provenance.

pack_dir.title: Memory pack folder
pack_dir.description: The folder holding your pack: MEMORY.md, README.md, records.jsonl and SHA256SUMS (and SHA256SUMS.sig if it is signed).

trusted_keys.title: Trusted keys file (optional)
trusted_keys.description: A file of public keys you trust to sign packs, one per line: name ssh-ed25519 AAAA…. Leave empty if your pack is not signed.

trusted_fingerprint.title: Pinned signer fingerprint (recommended for signed packs)
trusted_fingerprint.description: The SHA256:… fingerprint of the key that signs your packs, as sign-pack or ssh-keygen -l prints it; separate several with commas. If set, only a pack signed by this key starts, whatever the trusted keys file says. Leave empty for unsigned packs.

revoked_keys.title: Revoked keys file (optional)
revoked_keys.description: A file of key fingerprints you no longer trust, one SHA256:… per line. A pack signed by one of them never starts, even if pinned or trusted.

min_sequence.title: Minimum pack sequence (optional)
min_sequence.description: A whole number. Refuse to start on a pack whose signed sequence is missing or lower, so an older pack cannot be swapped in for a newer one. Raise it when you install a newer pack. Leave empty to turn off.

require_signature.title: Require a trusted signature
require_signature.description: Refuse to start unless the pack is signed by a key in the trusted keys file.

strict.title: Strict: require a trusted signature and an unexpired pack
strict.description: Refuse to start unless the pack is signed by a pinned or trusted key and carries an expiry date that has not passed; a running server stops answering once the pack expires.
